## README.md
# public-wgfd — Wyoming Game & Fish Department

Wildlife habitat data published by the Wyoming Game & Fish Department (WGFD). The department maps
big-game seasonal ranges across Wyoming, its area of jurisdiction, so these datasets cover the state
in full — they are not regional excerpts of a national product.

Datasets are grouped by the agency that produces them, which is how they are found and cited
upstream.

STAC: <https://s3-west.nrp-nautilus.io/public-wgfd/stac-collection.json>

## Collections

| dataset | polygons | acres | H3 |
|---|---:|---:|---|
| [`elk-crucial`](https://s3-west.nrp-nautilus.io/public-wgfd/elk-crucial/stac-collection.json) | 150 | 4,442,987 | native 10, parents 9/8/0 |
| [`mule-deer-crucial`](https://s3-west.nrp-nautilus.io/public-wgfd/mule-deer-crucial/stac-collection.json) | 145 | 6,431,769 | native 10, parents 9/8/0 |
| [`pronghorn-crucial`](https://s3-west.nrp-nautilus.io/public-wgfd/pronghorn-crucial/stac-collection.json) | 105 | 5,972,722 | native 10, parents 9/8/0 |

Each has three assets: a flat GeoParquet, PMTiles for web maps, and an H3 hex table at
resolution 10 carrying resolution 9, 8 and 0 identifiers.

**Crucial range** is the subset of seasonal range that WGFD identifies as a determining factor in a
population's ability to sustain itself. The department publishes it separately from full seasonal
range, which is why every `RANGE` code here begins with `CRU`.

`RANGE` values present: `CRUWYL` (crucial winter/yearlong), `CRUWIN` (crucial winter),
`CRUSWR` (crucial severe winter relief).

## DuckDB

```sql
INSTALL spatial; LOAD spatial;

-- acreage by range type
SELECT "RANGE", COUNT(*) AS polygons, ROUND(SUM("Acres")) AS acres
FROM read_parquet('https://s3-west.nrp-nautilus.io/public-wgfd/elk-crucial.parquet')
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY acres DESC;
```

The hex table has one row per polygon-and-cell pair, so `Acres` and `SQMiles` repeat across every
cell a polygon covers. Reduce to one row per polygon before totalling them:

```sql
-- correct: dedup to one row per polygon first
SELECT ROUND(SUM("Acres")) AS acres
FROM (SELECT DISTINCT _cng_fid, "Acres"
      FROM read_parquet('https://s3-west.nrp-nautilus.io/public-wgfd/elk-crucial/hex/h0=*/data_0.parquet'));
```

Joining to another dataset in this catalog goes through `h8`, the shared resolution:

```sql
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT e.h8) AS shared_cells
FROM read_parquet('https://s3-west.nrp-nautilus.io/public-wgfd/elk-crucial/hex/h0=*/data_0.parquet') e
JOIN read_parquet('https://s3-west.nrp-nautilus.io/public-wgfd/mule-deer-crucial/hex/h0=*/data_0.parquet') m
  USING (h8);
```

## MapLibre GL JS

The `source-layer` is the dataset name — `elk-crucial`, `mule-deer-crucial`, `pronghorn-crucial`.

```js
map.addSource('elk', {
  type: 'vector',
  url: 'pmtiles://https://s3-west.nrp-nautilus.io/public-wgfd/elk-crucial.pmtiles'
});

map.addLayer({
  id: 'elk-crucial-fill',
  type: 'fill',
  source: 'elk',
  'source-layer': 'elk-crucial',   // = the dataset name
  paint: {
    'fill-color': [
      'match', ['get', 'RANGE'],
      'CRUWYL', '#2d6a4f',
      'CRUWIN', '#40916c',
      'CRUSWR', '#95d5b2',
      '#cccccc'
    ],
    'fill-opacity': 0.6
  }
});
```

## Provenance

WGFD distributes through an ArcGIS Hub endpoint with no stable versioned download URL, so the
retained source under `raw/` is the reproducible anchor. Each collection's `sci:citation` records the
access date, the staged object, and its SHA-256.
